Important notes

Confirm the latest applicable amount before payment.

Fee details are subject to institutional confirmation and may change. Please contact the admissions office for the latest applicable fee structure before making any payment.

  • Clinical duty charges as per management.
  • Examination fees as per university rules.
  • Transportation cost will be extra.
  • Discount will be disbursed on percentage basis which student got in intermediate.
  • SC ST reservation available.
